mapper.sql: id, owner_id, name, description, category, body, visibility, version, enabled, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM skill WHERE visibility = 'PUBLIC' AND enabled = 1
SELECT FROM skill WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} AND visibility = 'PRIVATE' AND enabled = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO skill (owner_id, name, description, category, body, visibility, version, enabled) VALUES (#{ownerId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{category}, #{body}, #{visibility}, COALESCE(#{version}, 1), COALESCE(#{enabled}, 1)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE description = VALUES(description), category = VALUES(category), body = VALUES(body), visibility = VALUES(visibility), version = version + 1, enabled = VALUES(enabled)

INSERT INTO skill (owner_id, name, description, category, body, visibility, version, enabled) VALUES (#{ownerId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{category}, #{body}, #{visibility}, COALESCE(#{version}, 1), COALESCE(#{enabled}, 1)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM skill WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} AND name = #{name}
